title: BDB alert settings with threshold object
summary: Documents the bdb_alert_settings_with_threshold object used with Redis Enterprise Software REST API calls.

sections.title: Content
sections.text:
| Name | Type/Value | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| enabled    | boolean (default: false)  | Alert enabled or disabled |
| threshold  | string                         | Threshold for alert going on/off |
